content: शैक्षः [शिक्षां वेत्त्यधीते वा अण्] .²1 A student who studies Śikṣā or the science of pronunciation, one who has just entered upon the study of the Vedas. .²2 (Hence) A novice, tyro. --{%a.%} Well familiar with the studies or sciences; expert; <ls>Mb. 6. 97. 28</ls> (<ab>com.</ab> शैक्षं शस्त्रादिशिक्षासंपन्नम्).
